# `gcp.extensionbinding`

`ExtensionBinding` is a resource representing the attachment of an extension to a service.

[networkservices](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `networkservices.googleapis.com/ExtensionBinding` |
